plain_description.what: Plans to compare three ways of building the 'no structure' baseline for split certificates: the plain one and two stricter statistical variants. Each is tested on artificial data with planted 2-way structure and on structureless data. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Looks for a certificate baseline that detects real 2-way splits without certifying random clouds.
plain_description.information: Would show whether any baseline can certify the tree's binary splits fairly, or whether none can. Result: registered but not run yet.
